description: Search SmogRank's cities by name (local, old and short names too: "München", "Bombay", "NYC"), or find the nearest ones to a point. Returns each city's path for the other tools, whether it is measured by ground monitors (ranked) or only estimated from a model, and its page; a name search also returns the countries and regions it names, as places with their page.

lat.description: Latitude, with lon, instead of a name.

query.description: City name, optionally with region or country: "Springfield, Illinois".

name: find_city
title: Find a city
